messages:
Maya Singh: Quick kickoff 10-min mini-workshop w/CloudFuse on July 26. Goal: short talk + 30-min hands-on sandbox. Need owner for speaker rotation, workshop signups cap, fallback video, and last-mile swag returns.

Ethan Brooks: I can map the speaker rotation. Suggest NA slot 11:00 PT, repeat APAC 09:00 SGT later the week. Who takes rehearsal scheduling?

Rosa Li: I'll run rehearsals. Please send slides + demos 72h before rehearsal.

Jordan Kim: Infra note: we'll provision a ephemeral lab with 50 concurrent seats and TTL tokens expiring 18h after issue. Tokens minted per registration ID.

Maya Singh: Great. @Pat can you handle courier & customs? Need a small kit: sticker pack + quickstart card only.

Pat (logistics): Yep. SKU: RDW-SK-009 (stickers), RDW-CARD-003. Declared values: stickers $1.25, card $0.75. Shipping windows: US arrive by 7/22, SG by 7/23. I'll add HS codes.

Ethan Brooks: Fallback plan: Jordan, can you produce a 4-min recorded demo clip (MP4) as backup? Keep CLI snippet short.

Jordan Kim: Will do. Snippet for runbook:

```
# swap to hosted for live handoff
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=$SESSION_TOKEN
redwood demo --model redwood-mini --prompt "hello"
```

Rosa Li: Registration form: collect name, email, timezone, "ship swag?" checkbox (opt-in), and preferred session. Make shipping optional and only for opt-ins.

Maya Singh: Press/announce: Marketing will draft combined blurb; partners need 48h review. AnnounceBot please set embargo to 7/26 14:00 PT.

AnnounceBot: Embargo set for 7/26 14:00 PT. Reminder for rehearsal 7/24 11:00 PT.

Pat (logistics): Note on returns: if undeliverable, items held 21 days then donated. We'll notify recipients of failed delivery and attempt address confirmation first.

Ethan Brooks: Final owners: Maya (partner runbook), Jordan (fallback + infra notes), Rosa (rehearsal), Pat (swag). Reconvene 7/20 for final go/no-go. :rocket:
